text.text_excerpt: No trip to Bourbon Street in NOLA would be complete without at least a couple of Grenades. Served in a tall plastic green, grenade shaped container, the things really do go down easy and get the party started. It was the perfect starter drink(s) all three nights of our visit. I'll admit, after reading everyone else's reviews and hearing first hand grenade experience, I actually expected them to be a bit more powerful. That was a good thing though, trust me! IMO, this location is the best of them all but a grenade is a grenade.

I loved this place. In the midst of all the crazy and out of control places on Bourbon St, you find a little hole in the wall dive bar with some great live jazz and some even better hand grenades. I know hand grenades are a touristy gimmick, but damn they really do the job: they taste great and they screw you up pretty quickly. The recipe to these hand grenades are secret, but you can tell there is lime juice, carbonated water, and some bitter liquors. Tropical Isle is my kinda atmosphere. I like how the stage is at the end of the bar because you can choose whether you want to look at the band or not. I recommend anyone getting started on Bourbon St to start here, get a couple of hand gre...

I heard about Tropical Isle on a travel blog before I visited NOLA so I already had this place bookmarked. They are known for their Hand Grenade Drink and also the shark attack. I stopped by with my sister on our long night on Bourbon Street. We were bar hopping that night so we shared a drink here before going elsewhere. I got the hand grenade which is very similar to a midori sour. It has melon liqueur in it. For some reason I couldn't feel even a slight buzz that whole night. I don't think the drinks were made that strong, but it was still fun to get. They played some oldies music here which was fun. Surprisingly it wasn't that packed! Stop by and get a drink here on your Bourbon Stree...
